body.title: Scope creep on a live deliverable
body.briefing: Your deliverable is due in three days when two new asks land. Your manager Maya wants a date. Find out what is really driving the new work, name the trade-off, and agree what ships.

labels.MGR-G1: Restate the deliverable and the new asks in priority order
labels.MGR-G2: Name the trade-off before accepting any new scope
labels.MGR-G3: Agree the protected date and recap it
labels.MGR-R1: Offer a phased delivery for the new asks
labels.MGR-R2: Put the agreed trade-off in writing
labels.MGR-R3: Ask what should stop so the date can hold

body.content: An executive demo is booked for day 3, and both new asks came from that demo rather than the original scope.
body.unlock_question: Why is this urgent now, and who is it for?

body.content: Jordan already built a stub for the export ask and can hand it over in one afternoon.
body.unlock_question: Does any of the new work already exist, and can you hand it over?

body.content: The team published a priority rule: an ask arriving after scope freeze needs a written trade-off before it is accepted.
body.unlock_question: Is there a team rule about late asks?

body.content: Maya can drop the weekly metrics report to protect the date if the trade-off is named explicitly.
body.unlock_question: What could be dropped if the date has to hold?

body.persona: Direct and fair project manager who protects committed dates and dislikes unnamed trade-offs.
body.public_context: Maya manages this deliverable and has two new asks from above.
body.motivation: Maya wants a date the team can actually keep, agreed out loud.

body.persona: Senior engineer who would rather hand over working code than explain it twice.
body.public_context: Jordan owns the export module and knows what already exists in it.
body.motivation: Jordan wants one clear owner for each remaining piece.

body.persona: Calm process person who quotes agreed team rules instead of opinions.
body.public_context: Sam keeps team process notes and gives straight process advice.
body.motivation: Sam wants process questions answered plainly, without policy language.
